title: TSMC installs first ASML dual wafer stage TWINSCAN platform

passages.note: ASML announces shipment of a production AT:750 to TSMC for Fab 12 in Hsinchu. TSMC pilot-line director Nun-Sian Tsai describes the productivity benefit relative to the installed AT:700S. The release identifies AT:1100, AT:750 and AT:400 as members of the dual-stage family.

lineage: The search index retains the release text. Direct opening of the original URL redirects to ASML’s news index. Contemporary EDN coverage separately preserves the shipment and the intended Fab 12 installation.
